title: Being woken up in the real world randomly and constantly once you become lucid .

classification.theory_summary: Author suggests something connected to the dream world may be causing real-world interruptions to prevent lucidity/remembering/figuring things out.
classification.skip_reason: No describable Mall World environment or in-dream locations/events; post is about waking-life interruptions when becoming lucid.

meta.author_theory: Feels like when they become lucid or are "dreaming about something important / figuring things out," they are "randomly woken up" by real-world events; "whatever is in the dream world" may be "working both sides" (dream world and real world) to prevent seeing/remembering/figuring things out.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenology present is waking-life interruption pattern tied to becoming lucid/deep sleep; no dream setting details (Mall World locations, navigation, entities) are described.
